text: A 48-person older-adult trial found daily walks lowered blood pressure about 3 points in people not on medication.
Coffee's memory benefit appeared only in mice, at a dose like eight cups daily.
Chinese call-centre volunteers working from home gained 13 percent productivity, mostly by taking fewer breaks.
The new bridge saves northside drivers about four minutes on average, measured during school holidays.
Mixed trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds only in deficient people, about one fewer cold per 30 yearly.
A four-week reading app test improved children's letter recognition but not story comprehension.
Lab tests: a pesticide at ten times field doses shortened bee foraging trips but did not kill colonies.
A four-day week trial run by volunteer firms, without a comparison group, cut weekly hours from 38 to 34.
